gar.name: Rink value (GAR / WAR)
gar.about: Our goals above a replacement-level player: even-strength impact, power play, penalty kill, finishing and penalties, and the wins they are worth.

rapm.name: RAPM
rapm.about: Regularised adjusted plus-minus on our expected goals: a skater's isolated effect on xG for and against at 5v5.

xg.name: Our expected-goals model
xg.about: Our shot model: the chance each unblocked attempt becomes a goal, from distance, angle, type and the play before.

gsax.name: Goalie model (GSAx)
gsax.about: Goals saved above expected from our shot model: saves made over what an average goalie would make on the same shots.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Our game model's team rating, with 5v5 offence and defence, special teams and goaltending parts.

proj.name: Projection model
proj.about: Rest-of-season points, goals and on-ice xG share from recency-weighted rates regressed to the position mean.

gar_60: Goals above a replacement-level player per 60 minutes, from our value model (even-strength impact, power play, penalty kill, finishing, penalties).
p60: Goals plus assists per 60 minutes, all situations.
ixg60_all: Expected goals from the player's own shots per 60 minutes, all situations: how much scoring chance the player creates for themselves.
icf60: The player's own shot attempts (on goal, missed or blocked) per 60 minutes at 5-on-5: the steadiest individual stat in hockey.
adj_xgf_pct: Share of 5-on-5 expected goals the team gets with the player on the ice, adjusted for score and venue.
xgf60_rel: xG for per 60, relative to team (5v5)
How many more expected goals per 60 the team creates at 5-on-5 with the player on the ice than without.
rapm_net: 5-on-5 expected-goal differential per 60 after accounting for team-mates, opponents, zone starts and score.
pen_diff60: Penalties drawn minus penalties taken per 60 minutes; each one is a power play for or against.
toi_gp: Minutes per game in all situations: how much the coach trusts the player.
xfsh_pct: ixG per unblocked attempt: shot quality.
hd_att60: Unblocked attempts with xG of 0.20 or more, per 60.
shooting_talent: Shrunk finishing: goals above xG on a manned net regressed toward the league by the stabilisation constant of finishing, gax x attempts / (attempts + k).
cf_pct: On-ice share of shot attempts at 5v5.
cf_pct_rel: CF% on ice minus the team's CF% without the player (in the games played).
adj_xga60: Expected goals the team allows per 60 at 5-on-5 with the player on the ice, adjusted for score and venue (lower is better).
rapm_off: Expected goals for per 60 added at 5-on-5 after accounting for team-mates, opponents, zone starts and score.
rapm_def: Expected goals against per 60 prevented at 5-on-5 after accounting for team-mates, opponents, zone starts and score.
ozs_pct: Offensive-zone share of the 5v5 faceoffs (O + D) taken with the player on ice.
qoc_toi: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the opponents faced.
qot_toi: TOI-weighted mean 5v5 TOI per game of the team-mates on ice.
on_sh_pct: Team shooting % with the player on ice.
war: GAR in wins (goals per win from the season's scoring).
gar: Goals above replacement: RAPM offence and defence at 5v5, power play, penalty kill, shooting talent, penalties and faceoffs, against a replacement-level skater.
gsax100: Goals saved above expected per 100 shots
Goals stopped beyond what an average goalie would on the same shots (by our expected-goals model), per 100 unblocked shots faced.
gsax: Season total of goals saved beyond an average goalie facing the same shots.
sv_pct: Saves per shot on goal, all situations.
sv_pct_high: Save rate on high-danger chances (expected-goal value 0.20 or more).
sv_pct_med: Save rate on medium-danger chances (expected-goal value 0.08 to 0.20).
sv_pct_low: Save rate on low-danger chances (expected-goal value under 0.08).
qs_pct: Share of starts with a save percentage above league average (or .885 on 20 shots or fewer).
dfsv_pct: Unblocked save % minus expected unblocked save %.
gsax_shrunk: GSAx regressed toward zero by its stabilisation constant.
reb_rate: Saves followed within 3 s by another attempt by the shooting team, per save.
xg_per_shot: Mean xG of the unblocked attempts faced.
hd_share: Share of unblocked attempts faced that were high danger.
start_share: Share of the team's games started.
gsax_low: GSAx on attempts with xG under 0.08.
gsax_high: GSAx on attempts with xG 0.20 or more.
gsax_wrist: GSAx on wrist and snap shots.
edge_hd_sv_pct: Save % from NHL puck and player tracking, from high-danger areas.
edge_md_sv_pct: Save % from NHL puck and player tracking, from mid-range.
edge_ld_sv_pct: Save % from NHL puck and player tracking, from long range.

rating: Our team-strength model: expected goal differential per game against an average team, all situations.
xgf_pct5: Share of 5-on-5 expected goals the team gets.
cf_pct5: Share of 5-on-5 shot attempts the team gets: puck possession.
off5: Expected goals created per 60 minutes at 5-on-5.
def5: Expected goals allowed per 60 minutes at 5-on-5 (lower is better).
pp: Expected goals created per 60 minutes on the power play.
pk: Expected goals allowed per 60 minutes short-handed (lower is better).
goalie: Goals the team's goalies saved above expected per 60 minutes.
gd_g: Goals for minus goals against per game (shootout winners excluded).
pts_pct: Standings points taken as a share of the points available.
gf_g: Goals scored per game, all situations.
ga_g: Goals allowed per game, all situations. Lower is better.
xgf_g: Expected goals created per game from shot quality, all situations.
xga_g: Expected goals allowed per game from shot quality, all situations. Lower is better.
pp_pct: Share of power plays that produce a goal.
pk_pct: Share of opponent power plays killed without conceding.
gsax: Goals the team's goalies saved above what the shots they faced would predict.
pp_gf60: Power-play goals scored per 60 minutes of power-play time.
pk_ga60: Goals allowed per 60 minutes of penalty-kill time. Lower is better.
ff_pct5: Share of unblocked shot attempts at 5v5 taken by this team.
gf_pct5: Share of 5v5 goals scored by this team.

view.why: Forwards: individual expected goals per 60 against points per 60, coloured by value per 60.
Defencemen: isolated defence (chances allowed) against points per 60, coloured by value per 60.
Goaltenders: goals saved above expected per 100 shots against quality-start rate, coloured by total goals saved above expected.
